# hi-key

> hi-key is an iOS keyboard that generates AI images from text prompts. Install it once, and it works inside any app on your iPhone: iMessage, WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, Slack, Notes, email, and more. Type a description, get 4 images in seconds, copy and paste anywhere.

## How it works

1. Enable hi-key as a keyboard on your iPhone (one-time setup in Settings).
2. In any app, switch to hi-key using the globe icon, just like switching to the emoji keyboard.
3. Type a description of what you want to see.
4. hi-key generates 4 AI images in seconds.
5. Tap any image to copy it, then paste it into your conversation or post.

No app switching required. The entire flow happens inside the app you're already using.

## Key features

- Works in any app with a text input: iMessage, WhatsApp, Instagram DMs, Telegram, Slack, Notes, email, and more
- Generates 4 images per prompt, so you can pick the one you like best
- Fast enough to use mid-conversation: images arrive in seconds, not minutes
- Privacy-first: only your prompts are processed, never stored after generation. hi-key never reads your messages, passwords, or other content
- No account required: download and start generating immediately
- Custom iOS keyboard extension: available everywhere you type, no app switching

## Pricing

hi-key uses a credit system. 1 credit = 1 prompt = 4 images.

### Subscriptions (monthly)

- Free: 5 credits (one-time, included with download)
- Starter: $4.99/month for 25 credits
- Plus: $6.99/month for 50 credits
- Super: $12.99/month for 110 credits (no watermark, early access to new features)

### One-time credit packs

- Mini: $2.99 for 10 credits
- Big: $5.99 for 25 credits

### Early member offer

Everyone who joins the waitlist gets 2x credits on every purchase, forever. Buy 25 credits, get 50. Applies to both subscriptions and one-time packs. The bonus never expires.

### Referral program

Refer a friend and you both get 5 extra credits.

## How hi-key is different

Most AI image generators (ChatGPT, Midjourney, DALL-E) require you to leave your conversation, open a separate app, wait for results, save the image, and come back to paste it. This takes time and breaks your flow.

hi-key is a keyboard. It lives inside the app you're already using. You don't switch apps, you don't wait. It's like sending a GIF, but personal and unique.

Compared to Nano Banana and similar keyboard-based tools, hi-key generates 4 images per prompt (not 1) and uses ultra-fast models to deliver results in seconds.

## Privacy

- hi-key only processes the text you type in the hi-key prompt bar
- Prompts are processed securely and not stored after image generation
- hi-key never reads, stores, or sends your messages, passwords, or any other content
- No account or login required to use the app

## FAQ

**What is hi-key?**
hi-key is an iOS keyboard that generates AI images from text prompts. Switch to it like you switch to the emoji keyboard, type a description, and get 4 images in seconds.

**Which apps does hi-key work in?**
Any app with a text input: iMessage, WhatsApp, Instagram DMs, Telegram, Slack, Notes, email, and more. It's a system keyboard, so it's available everywhere you type.

**Is hi-key free?**
You get 5 free credits to start. Each credit generates 4 images. For more credits, one-time packs start at $2.99 and subscriptions at $4.99/month.

**Is hi-key safe?**
Yes. hi-key only processes your prompts and never reads your messages or other content. No account required.

**How is hi-key different from ChatGPT or Midjourney?**
hi-key is a keyboard, not a separate app. It works inside the app you're already using, generates 4 images in seconds, and requires no app switching.
